title: Sujeonggwa: Korean Cinnamon-Ginger Punch with Pine Nuts
summary: A fragrant, spiced punch made from charred cinnamon, fresh ginger, and dark brown sugar, served warm or chilled.
equipment: gas burner or dry frying pan

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Using tongs, char 5 cinnamon sticks over a gas flame or in a dry pan for about 30 s until lightly blackened and fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Put the charred cinnamon, 170 g thinly sliced fresh ginger and 1400 ml water in a large pan, bring to the boil, then lower and simmer 20 min.

steps.title: Spice
steps.text: Stir in 200 g dark brown sugar, 8 whole cloves and 2 star anise and simmer 5 min more until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Steep
steps.text: Turn off the heat and steep 10 min.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Strain through a fine sieve into a jug, discarding the spices and ginger.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm, or cool and chill at least 2 h, then float a few of the 1 tbsp pine nuts on each serving.

tips: Charring the cinnamon sticks briefly over a flame releases their essential oils and deepens the flavour.
The drink can be made ahead and chilled; it tastes even better the next day.
storage: Serve warm immediately, or cool and chill for at least 2 hours before serving cold. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
